about: flatwire cross-language conformance corpus. Each case is a top-level collection (the unit flatwire streams). Runners in every language encode+decode each case in each supported format, record whether it round-trips, and hash the encoded bytes so an aggregator can prove which cases are byte-identical across runtimes. 'tier' documents the strongest claim we make: 'identical' = byte-identical encode expected across all languages; 'roundtrip' = semantic round-trip only (encoding legitimately varies, e.g. float text, so byte-identity is not claimed).
